## Stat1

### ChIP-Atlas

```{r }
chip_stat1 <- fread(file.path(params$data_dir, "Stat1_chipatlas.tsv")) %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::select(c("Target_genes", "Stat1|Average"))
head(chip_stat1)
```

```{r}
v <- chip_stat1$`Stat1|Average`

library(inflection)

v_sorted <- sort(v, decreasing = TRUE)
x <- seq_along(v_sorted)

knee <- uik(x, v_sorted)

df <- data.frame(index = x, value = v_sorted)

ggplot(df, aes(index, value)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue") +
  geom_point() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = knee, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate("text", x = knee, y = max(v_sorted),
           label = paste("Knee point=", round(knee)),
           hjust = -0.1, color = "red") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(y = "ChIP-Atlas average score")
```

### SIGNOR

```{r eval=FALSE}
## Requires internet access -----------------------------------------------

url <- "https://signor.uniroma2.it/getData.php"

signor_cols <- c(
  "ENTITYA", "TYPEA", "IDA", "DATABASEA",
  "ENTITYB", "TYPEB", "IDB", "DATABASEB",
  "EFFECT", "MECHANISM", "RESIDUE", "SEQUENCE",
  "TAX_ID", "CELL_DATA", "TISSUE_DATA",
  "MODULATOR_COMPLEX", "TARGET_COMPLEX",
  "MODIFICATIONA", "MODASEQ", "MODIFICATIONB", "MODBSEQ",
  "PMID", "DIRECT", "NOTES", "ANNOTATOR", "SENTENCE",
  "SIGNOR_ID", "SCORE", "LINKOUT"
)

resp <- GET(url, query = list(id = "P42225", organism = "10090"))
stop_for_status(resp)

signor_raw <- read_tsv(
  content(resp, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8"),
  col_names = signor_cols,
  col_types = cols(.default = "c")
)

stat1_regulon <- signor_raw %>%
  filter(ENTITYA == "STAT1",
         MECHANISM == "transcriptional regulation") %>%
  mutate(mor = case_when(
    grepl("up-regulates",   EFFECT) ~ 1,
    grepl("down-regulates", EFFECT) ~ -1,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )) %>%
  transmute(source = "STAT1",
            target = ENTITYB,
            mor,
            signor_score = as.numeric(SCORE),
            pmid = PMID)
write_csv(stat1_regulon, file = file.path(params$data_dir, "stat1_regulons_signor.csv"))
```

# Activity inference

```{r}
contrast_acts <- lapply(res_list, function(res_sub){

  sign_fc <-  data.frame(sign_fc = -log10(res_sub$PValue) * res_sub$logFC)
  rownames(sign_fc) <- make.unique(res_sub$Symbol)

  decoupleR::run_ulm(mat = sign_fc,
                    net = net,
                    .source = 'source',
                    .target = 'target',
                    .mor='mor',
                    minsize = 5)

})
```

```{r}
tf_lookup <- res_list$VEH |>
  distinct(SYMBOL, DESCRIPTION, GENEID) |>
  filter(SYMBOL %in% unique(net$source))
library(org.Mm.eg.db)

missing <- setdiff(unique(net$source), tf_lookup$SYMBOL)

extra <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  org.Mm.eg.db,
  keys     = missing,
  keytype  = "SYMBOL",
  columns  = c("GENENAME", "ENSEMBL")
) |>
  transmute(SYMBOL, DESCRIPTION = GENENAME, GENEID = ENSEMBL) |>
  distinct(SYMBOL, .keep_all = TRUE)

tf_lookup <- bind_rows(tf_lookup, extra)
tf_lookup <- tf_lookup |>
  mutate(DESCRIPTION = coalesce(DESCRIPTION, "complex / unmapped in org.Mm.eg.db"))
tf_lookup$DESCRIPTION[tf_lookup$SYMBOL == "Stat1_chip"] <- "Stat1 - recovered from ChIP-Atlas"
tf_lookup$DESCRIPTION[tf_lookup$SYMBOL == "Stat1_signor"] <- "Stat1 - recovered from SIGNOR"
for(i in names(contrast_acts)){
  contrast_acts[[i]]$DESCRIPTION <- tf_lookup$DESCRIPTION[match(contrast_acts[[i]]$source, tf_lookup$SYMBOL)]
  contrast_acts[[i]] <- contrast_acts[[i]] |> relocate(DESCRIPTION, .after = source)
}

contrast_acts <- lapply(contrast_acts, function(x) {
  x$padj <- p.adjust(x$p_value, method = "BH")
  x
})
```

## Results summary

```{r}
library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(knitr); library(kableExtra)

tf_summary <- bind_rows(contrast_acts, .id = "contrast") |>
  mutate(contrast = factor(contrast,
                           levels = c("VEH","AZA_Tcells"))) |>
  group_by(contrast) |>
  summarise(
    n_tested  = n(),
    Activated = sum(padj < 0.05 & score > 0),
    Repressed = sum(padj < 0.05 & score < 0),
    Total     = Activated + Repressed,
    top_TF    = source[which.min(padj)],
    top_padj  = formatC(min(padj), format = "e", digits = 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(contrast)

tf_summary |>
  kable(
    caption   = "Significant transcription factor activity per contrast (CollecTRI / decoupleR ULM, KO vs Control, BH FDR < 0.05)",
    col.names = c("Contrast", "TFs tested", "Activated in KO", "Repressed in KO",
                  "Total", "Top TF", "Top FDR"),
    align     = c("l", rep("r", 4), "l", "r"),
    booktabs  = TRUE
  ) |>
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE,
                bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed")) |>
  add_header_above(c(" " = 2, "Significant TFs" = 3, "Strongest hit" = 2)) |>
  column_spec(3, color = "#B40426") |>
  column_spec(4, color = "#3B4CC0")
```

# Shared TFs

## Table of shared TFs

```{r results='asis'}
library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(ggplot2); library(forcats); library(tibble)
acts <- bind_rows(contrast_acts, .id = "contrast") |>
  mutate(contrast = factor(contrast,
                           levels = c("VEH",  "AZA_Tcells"))) |>
  group_by(contrast) |>
  mutate(rank_padj = rank(padj, ties.method = "min")) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(dir = if_else(score > 0, "Activated in KO", "Repressed in KO"),
         sig = padj < 0.05)

share <- acts |>
  filter(sig) |>
  group_by(source) |>
  summarise(DESCRIPTION  = dplyr::first(DESCRIPTION),
            n_contrast   = n(),
            contrasts    = paste(as.character(contrast), collapse = " | "),
            n_up         = sum(score > 0),
            n_down       = sum(score < 0),
            mean_score   = mean(score),
            best_padj    = min(padj),
            average_rank = mean(rank_padj),
            .groups      = "drop") |>
  mutate(consistent = (n_up == 0 | n_down == 0)) |>
  arrange(average_rank)

print(htmltools::tagList(
    default_dt(
      share
    ) |>
      formatSignif(columns = c("best_padj"), digits = 3) |>
      formatRound(columns = c("mean_score", "average_rank"), digits = 2)
  ))
```

## Dotplot {.tabset}

```{r results='asis'}
library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(tibble); library(ggplot2)

tf_pattern <- function(acts,
                       required,
                       forbidden,
                       sig_cut       = 0.05,
                       forbidden_cut = 0.05,
                       order_by      = "cluster",
                       title,
                       subtitle = NULL) {

  padj_wide <- acts |>
    dplyr::select(source, contrast, padj) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = contrast, values_from = padj)

  keep <- padj_wide |>
    filter(if_all(all_of(required),  ~ .x <  sig_cut),
           if_all(all_of(forbidden), ~ .x >= forbidden_cut)) |>
    pull(source)

  if (length(keep) == 0) {
    message("No TFs match this pattern: ", title)
    return(list(tfs = character(0), table = acts[0, ], plot = NULL))
  }

  ## ---- row ordering -------------------------------------------------------
  score_mat <- acts |>
    filter(source %in% keep) |>
    dplyr::select(source, contrast, score) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = contrast, values_from = score) |>
    column_to_rownames("source") |> as.matrix()

  tf_order <- if (identical(order_by, "cluster")) {
    if (length(keep) >= 3) rownames(score_mat)[hclust(dist(score_mat))$order] else keep
  } else {
    rownames(score_mat)[order(score_mat[, order_by])]
  }

  ## ---- table (all 4 contrasts kept, so you can see the non-significant arms)
  tbl <- acts |>
    filter(source %in% keep) |>
    mutate(source  = factor(source, levels = tf_order),
           pattern = title) |>
    arrange(desc(source), contrast) |>
    dplyr::select(pattern, source, DESCRIPTION, contrast, score, dir,
                  p_value, padj, rank_padj, sig)

  ## ---- plot ---------------------------------------------------------------
  p <- acts |>
    filter(source %in% keep) |>
    mutate(source = factor(source, levels = tf_order)) |>
    ggplot(aes(contrast, source)) +
    geom_point(aes(size = pmin(-log10(padj), 6), fill = score, colour = sig),
               shape = 21, stroke = 0.4) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#3B4CC0", mid = "white", high = "#B40426",
                         midpoint = 0, name = "ULM score\n(+ = up in KO)") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "grey15", `FALSE` = "grey80"),
                        name = "FDR < 0.05", labels = c("no", "yes")) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 7), name = expression(-log[10]~FDR),
                          breaks = c(1.3, 3, 6), labels = c("0.05", "0.001", "≤1e-6")) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = title, subtitle = subtitle) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4, fill = "white"))) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

  list(tfs = tf_order, table = tbl, plot = p)
}
```

# Top 5 TF per contrast

```{r}
## gene-level statistic, long form ----------------------------------------
de_long <- bind_rows(res_list, .id = "contrast") |>
  transmute(contrast = factor(contrast, levels = levels(acts$contrast)),
            gene = SYMBOL, logFC, PValue, FDR,
            sign_fc = -log10(PValue) * logFC)

top5 <- acts |>
  group_by(contrast) |>
  slice_max(abs(score), n = 5, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  arrange(contrast, desc(score)) |>
  mutate(label = paste0(contrast, " — ", source,
                        "\nt = ", round(score, 2), ", FDR = ", signif(padj, 2)),
         label = factor(label, levels = unique(label)))

## --- diagnostic frame, with DE status of each target ----------------------
pal <- c("Activated target (DE)"   = "#B40426",
         "Activated target (n.s.)" = "#F0A9A0",
         "Repressed target (DE)"   = "#3B4CC0",
         "Repressed target (n.s.)" = "#A3B8E8")

diag_df <- top5 |>
  dplyr::select(contrast, source, label) |>
  left_join(de_long, by = "contrast", relationship = "many-to-many") |>
  left_join(net, by = c("source", "gene" = "target")) |>
  mutate(mor = replace_na(mor, 0),
         target_sig = FDR < 0.05,
         role = case_when(
           mor ==  0                ~ "Not a target",
           mor ==  1 &  target_sig  ~ "Activated target (DE)",
           mor ==  1 & !target_sig  ~ "Activated target (n.s.)",
           mor == -1 &  target_sig  ~ "Repressed target (DE)",
           mor == -1 & !target_sig  ~ "Repressed target (n.s.)"),
         role = factor(role, levels = c(names(pal), "Not a target")))
```

## Top TFs gene summary

###  Top 5 TFs

```{r results='asis'}
tf_support <- diag_df |>
  filter(mor != 0) |>
  group_by(contrast, source) |>
  summarise(n_targets     = n(),
            n_activating  = sum(mor == 1),
            n_repressing  = sum(mor == -1),
            n_target_sig  = sum(FDR < 0.05),
            perc_target_sig = sum(FDR < 0.05)/ n(),
            concordant    = mean(sign(sign_fc) == sign(mor)),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  left_join(top5 |> dplyr::select(contrast, source, score, padj, DESCRIPTION),
            by = c("contrast", "source")) |>
  arrange(contrast, desc(abs(score))) |>
  relocate(DESCRIPTION, .after = source)

print(htmltools::tagList(
    default_dt(
      tf_support
    ) |>
      formatSignif(columns = c("padj"), digits = 3) |>
      formatRound(columns = c("perc_target_sig", "concordant", "score"), digits = 2)
  ))
```

## IFN/ inflammatory response

```{r}
library(dplyr); library(writexl)

table_dir <- params$table_dir

## --- assemble the essential tables ----------------------------------------
tf_tables <- list(
  summary_per_contrast = tf_summary,
  TF_activity_all      = acts |> arrange(contrast, padj),
  shared_TFs           = share,
  pattern_combo_only   = combo_only$table,
  top5_target_support  = tf_support,
  TF_annotation        = tf_lookup
)

tf_tables <- tf_tables[vapply(tf_tables, \(x) !is.null(x) && nrow(x) > 0, logical(1))]

## --- CSV: one file per table ----------------------------------------------
invisible(lapply(names(tf_tables), function(nm) {
  readr::write_csv(
    tf_tables[[nm]] |> mutate(across(where(is.factor), as.character)),
    file.path(table_dir, paste0("TF_activity_", nm, ".csv"))
  )
}))

## --- Excel: one workbook, one sheet per table -----------------------------
write_xlsx(
  lapply(tf_tables, \(x) x |> mutate(across(where(is.factor), as.character))),
  path = file.path(table_dir, "TF_activity_decoupleR_CollecTRI.xlsx")
)

saveRDS(net, file.path(params$data_dir, "collectri_mouse_stat1Extended.rds"))
```
